text_block_list.text:
One day, several boxes full of fan letters
arrived for Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —I am deeply humbled and grateful, truly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun. If I recall correctly,
we still have some time before training today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Could you let me read these in the meantime?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
I'll be sure to read it carefully.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Through their races, the Umamusume running in the Twinkle Series
allow fans to see all kinds of dreams."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, thanks to the support of our fans, we are able to run toward our dreams...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I find this recurring cycle truly precious.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I want to carry every single bit of the fans' feelings
that drive me to run."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Because that is my—
an Umamusume's way of doing things.

From the way she read, taking in every word after saying that,
I could deeply feel her love and respect for her fans.
